Privacy & data
How Breeze HR processes and protects your data.
UK GDPR notice: The company using Breeze HR is the data controller for employee data processed through this platform. Breeze HR acts as a data processor. Configure your data retention period under Settings.
What data Breeze HR processes

When you use Breeze HR, the following data is processed:

  • HR conversations - chat messages, questions and AI responses
  • Company documents - HR policies, handbooks and templates you upload
  • Employee data - names, job titles, salaries and other personal details entered when generating letters and contracts
  • Meeting notes - transcripts and written notes from recorded meetings
  • Email content - if you connect Gmail or Outlook, email content you view and draft responses to
  • Writing samples and style preferences - text pasted into Settings to train the writing style
  • Usage signals - ratings, edited drafts and conversation patterns used to improve response quality
Sub-processors

Breeze HR uses the following third-party sub-processors. Primary data storage is in the EU. Some sub-processors (Anthropic, Vercel, Composio) operate from the United States; appropriate transfer mechanisms (standard contractual clauses or equivalent) are in place for all international transfers.

ProviderPurposeLocation
AnthropicAI response generation - chat messages and documents are sent to Anthropic's APIUnited States
SupabaseDatabase storage - all company data, policies, chats and user accountsEU (Ireland)
VercelHosting and serverless functionsUnited States / EU
GoogleSpeech-to-Text transcription for meeting recordings (only if meeting recorder is used)United States
ComposioEmail and SharePoint integration (only if connected)United States
Lawful basis for processing

Processing of employee personal data through Breeze HR is carried out under the legitimate interests of the employer in managing its HR function efficiently, or under contractual necessity where applicable. Special category data (health, disciplinary matters) should only be entered where a specific lawful basis under UK GDPR Article 9 applies.

Meeting recordings

When using the meeting recorder, you are responsible for ensuring that all participants are aware the conversation will be transcribed by Google (Speech-to-Text) and then processed by Anthropic AI. Under UK GDPR and the Investigatory Powers Act 2016, recording individuals without their knowledge may be unlawful. Always obtain consent or inform participants before recording.

Data retention

Your account administrator can configure how long data is retained under Settings - Data & privacy. After the retention period, chat history, meeting notes and response data are automatically deleted. Uploaded policies and templates are kept until manually deleted. You can also delete all company data immediately from Settings.

Your rights under UK GDPR

As a data controller, your organisation is responsible for handling data subject rights requests from employees. Breeze HR provides tools to delete all stored data on request. Rights include: access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and the right to object.

Last updated: May 2026. This policy applies to Breeze HR (getbreeze.co.uk).
Before you record
This recording will be transcribed by Google (Speech-to-Text) and then processed by Anthropic AI. Under UK GDPR you must ensure all meeting participants are aware before recording begins.

Do not record employees without their knowledge.
FAQs
Everything you need to know about Breeze HR.
Security & data protection
Where is my data stored and how is it protected?
Your data is stored in Supabase - a SOC 2 Type II certified database platform built on PostgreSQL, hosted on AWS eu-west-1 (Ireland). Your data does not leave the EU.

Encryption at rest: All data is encrypted using AES-256 at the storage level.

Encryption in transit: All data transferred between your browser and our servers uses TLS 1.2 or higher. No data ever travels unencrypted.

Isolation between companies: We use Row Level Security (RLS) at the database layer. Every single record - your policies, chat history, documents, templates - is scoped to your company ID. It is technically not possible for one company's data to be read by another company's workspace, even by database administrators.

Authentication: Login is managed through Supabase Auth with secure session tokens. Each team member has their own login and can only access data their role permits.

The platform is hosted on Vercel's global edge network with EU region support. Sub-processors are listed in our Data Processing Agreement (DPA).
Does Breeze HR use my data to train AI?
No. Your data is never used to train AI models, and is not stored by Anthropic.

We operate under Anthropic's zero data retention agreement. This means that when your query is sent to Claude for processing, Anthropic does not store, log or retain the prompt or response on their servers at any point. The data is processed in memory and immediately discarded. There is no 30-day retention window that applies to standard API users - our agreement explicitly removes it.

This is the same commitment that enterprise HR platforms make. The query travels to Anthropic's servers over TLS 1.2+ encryption, is answered in real time, and leaves no trace on their side.

Your uploaded policies, chat history, documents and employee data remain exclusively in your isolated workspace on Supabase eu-west-1 (Ireland). They are used only to answer your queries - never to improve AI models, never shared with other companies, and not used by Breeze HR for any purpose beyond delivering the service to you.

This is a fundamental difference from consumer AI tools like ChatGPT where your inputs may contribute to model training. Enterprise HR data - disciplinaries, performance reviews, health information - should never be in scope for AI training. With Breeze HR, it isn't.
Is Breeze HR GDPR compliant?
Yes. Breeze HR is designed to comply with the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.

You are the controller. We are the processor. You control what data you put into the platform and you are responsible for having a lawful basis to do so. We process it only on your documented instructions as set out in our Data Processing Agreement (DPA).

Data processing agreement: A full DPA is available and incorporated into our terms. It covers lawful bases, sub-processors, breach notification timelines, data subject rights assistance and international transfer mechanisms.

Right to erasure: You can request deletion of all your company's data at any time. We will action this within 30 days and confirm in writing.

International transfers: Our sub-processors (Anthropic, Supabase, Vercel) are US-based. Appropriate transfer mechanisms are in place (standard contractual clauses or equivalent). This is disclosed in full in the DPA.

Special category data: HR data may include health information, disciplinary records and other sensitive categories. Our security measures are appropriate for this data type. You should conduct a DPIA if you are processing high-risk data at scale.
Who can access my company's data?
Only your authorised team members can access your company's workspace. You control who gets access through the Settings panel.

Breeze HR staff have strictly limited access to customer data - only where essential for technical support and only after logging. We do not read your chat history, employee data or documents as a matter of course.

Your AI queries are processed by Anthropic's API in real time under a zero data retention agreement - Anthropic does not store, log or retain any prompt or response on their servers.

No data is sold, shared with third parties for commercial purposes, or used in any way not described in our terms and DPA.
The platform
How is Breeze HR different from using ChatGPT or a general AI tool?
Most AI tools give you a generic answer based on what you typed. Breeze HR is an adaptive learning model that builds a picture of how your specific team works and gets measurably better the longer you use it.

It knows your business. Upload your HR policies and handbook and Breeze HR reads them first when answering questions - so every response reflects your actual rules, not generic guidance. If your policy says something different to ACAS, Breeze HR follows your policy.

It learns how you write. Every time you edit a draft before sending, Breeze HR's AI analyses exactly what changed - tone, word choices, phrases removed, sign-off used. These signals accumulate and shape every future response, without you having to explain your preferences.

It remembers what worked. Past responses your team approved are stored with semantic embeddings. When a similar situation comes up, Breeze HR retrieves the most relevant approved responses and writes in that style - getting closer to your team's voice with every use.

It connects to your documents. Link SharePoint and Breeze HR can search your actual files and use them as a reference when creating new ones.

It is built for UK HR. It knows ACAS codes of practice, current statutory rates, employment tribunal risk, and the correct process for grievances, disciplinaries, redundancy and more.
How does the learning model actually work?
Breeze HR is an adaptive learning model that builds a picture of how your specific team communicates and improves with every interaction.

AI-powered style analysis. Every time you edit a draft before sending, Breeze HR uses AI to analyse exactly what changed - not just length, but tone direction, specific word substitutions, phrases you remove, and your preferred sign-off. These signals are stored and aggregated across all your edits, so recurring patterns rise above one-off changes. After a handful of edited sends, Breeze HR starts writing in your house style without being told.

Semantic memory. Every query and approved response is stored with a semantic embedding. When a similar situation comes up, Breeze HR retrieves the most relevant past responses your team approved and uses them as style references - so it handles recurring queries in exactly the way your team has already validated.

Ratings. Use the thumbs up / thumbs down buttons on any response. Highly-rated responses are shown to Breeze HR as examples to match. Thumbs-down responses are shown as styles to avoid. These take effect immediately.

Your writing sample. Go to Settings and paste an example of how you write. Breeze HR matches your tone, vocabulary and phrasing across all drafts.

Explicit preferences. Say "make it shorter", "less formal" or "no bullet points" in any conversation and Breeze HR picks that up and applies it going forward.

The model is quiet for the first few sessions while data builds. After 10-15 edited sends, the responses will start to feel measurably more like your team wrote them.
Does Breeze HR stay up to date with UK employment law?
Breeze HR's statutory rates and employment law guidance are reviewed and updated by our team each April and when significant legislative changes occur. Current rates are built into the platform and flagged for verification where figures may have changed.

We recommend HR professionals verify any statutory figure before relying on it, particularly in the weeks following the April uprating. Last reviewed: April 2026.
Your data and documents
Can I upload my own HR policies and company handbook?
Yes - and this is one of the most important things to do when you set up. Go to Policies and upload your documents as PDF, Word or text files. You can upload individual policies (annual leave, disciplinary, grievance etc.) as well as your full company handbook.

Once uploaded, Breeze HR reads everything and uses your documents first when answering questions. If an employee asks about your flexible working policy, it answers based on your specific policy - not a generic description of the law. If your policy is more generous than the statutory minimum, Breeze HR will say so.

If no policy exists for a topic, Breeze HR falls back to ACAS guidance and UK employment law and flags that you may want to create a policy for it.
Can I connect SharePoint and use my existing documents?
Yes. Connect SharePoint under Settings using your Microsoft account. Once connected, Breeze HR can search your SharePoint files directly from the chat.

The most powerful use case is document creation. If you ask Breeze HR to create a job description for a new role, it automatically searches your SharePoint for existing job descriptions, tells you what it found, and offers to use the same format and structure. The result is a new document that matches your company's existing style - not a generic template.

You can also search SharePoint manually at any time using the SharePoint panel (the icon in the sidebar), and add documents directly to a chat conversation.
Is each company's data kept completely separate?
Yes, completely. Every company has its own isolated workspace. Your policies, chat history, templates, responses and documents are never visible to other users or other companies on the platform.

Data separation is enforced at the database level using Row Level Security (RLS) - every single record is scoped to your company ID at the database row level. This is not just application-layer logic: even if there were an application bug, the database itself prevents cross-company data access. No record can be retrieved without matching the requesting company's ID.

User logins are managed through a secure authentication layer. Each team member has their own credentials and session. Individual chat histories are private to each user - only shared assets (policies, templates, company handbook) are visible to all users on your account.
Do I need employee consent to use the meeting notes feature?
Yes - you should inform all participants before recording or transcribing any meeting. Under UK GDPR and the Investigatory Powers Act 2016, recording individuals without their knowledge is potentially unlawful, even for internal HR meetings.

Best practice is to notify participants at the start of the meeting that it will be transcribed for HR note-taking purposes. For disciplinary, grievance or formal HR meetings, we recommend noting consent in writing before using the feature.

The transcription is processed by Google Speech-to-Text (voice to text) and then summarised by Anthropic's AI. The resulting notes are stored only in your Breeze HR workspace and are not shared externally.
Documents and templates
What types of letters and documents can Breeze HR draft?
Over 25 built-in templates across contracts, letters and disciplinary documents:

Contracts: Standard employment contract, fixed term contract, internship agreement, contract variation, TUPE transfer letter.

Letters: Offer letter, promotion letter, salary increase, probation passed, flexible working approval and refusal, maternity and paternity confirmation, return to work, resignation acceptance, sickness absence review, settlement agreement, home working agreement.

Disciplinary and grievance: First written warning, final written warning, grievance acknowledgement, disciplinary hearing invite, dismissal letter, redundancy at-risk and confirmation letters, redundancy appeal outcome, performance improvement plan (PIP).

References: Standard employment reference, regulated reference (FCA/SYSC 22).

You can also upload your own Word or PDF templates. Mark variable fields with {curly brackets} or [square brackets] and Breeze HR detects them automatically, asks the right questions and fills the document in.
Can I upload my own contract or letter templates?
Yes. Go to Documents and click Upload template. Before uploading, mark any fields you want to fill in later using {curly brackets}, [square brackets] or <<angle brackets>> - for example {employee_name}, [Job Title] or <<start_date>>.

Breeze HR detects these automatically, creates a list of questions to fill each field, and builds the completed document live as you answer them. The final download is a Word file with your original formatting preserved.

This works with .docx, .pdf and .txt files. If your template uses a format like [PROBATION PERIOD, e.g. 3 months], Breeze HR strips the description and treats it as a fillable field.
Integrations and team access
Can I connect my email and manage HR correspondence in one place?
Yes. Connect Gmail or Outlook under Settings. Once connected, your inbox loads inside Breeze HR so you can read incoming emails, draft AI-assisted replies and send completed letters - all without leaving the platform.

Each team member connects their own personal email account, so emails remain private to them. Breeze HR can read the email you are responding to and use that context when drafting - so it knows who the employee is, what they asked and what the situation is before it writes a single word.
How do I get my whole HR team using Breeze HR?
Each team member creates their own account. Once you approve them (under Settings - you control who gets access), they log in and immediately have access to your company's uploaded policies, templates and handbook.

Their individual chat history, email connection and writing preferences are private to them. But the shared knowledge base - policies, templates, learning signals from edited drafts - builds up collectively. The more your team uses Breeze HR, the more it learns about how your specific company operates, and the better it gets for everyone on the team.
